away.summary: The Bruins (9-2-1) are riding a strong stretch, having won seven of their last eight games and four straight at home before a 6-4 win over San Jose. They will use the same projected lineup from that victory, with no new injuries reported. Young players like James Hagens, Fraser Minten, and Marat Khusnutdinov have provided significant offensive depth early in the season.

doubtful.detail: upper-body injury; practiced Monday and hopeful to play, but coach was non-committal

home.summary: The Hurricanes (9-2-2) are coming off a successful 3-1-1 State Fair road trip and are the first team to reach 20 standings points. They remain without Jordan Staal (calf), while Taylor Hall is hopeful to return after a five-game absence. Mark Jankowski is not yet available despite skating solo, though the projected lineup lists him as playing after missing four games with a lower-body injury.
